overall_prep_notes: Total prep ~1.5 hours. The two character puppets (Bella, Bobby) print on cardstock. Real balance scale is the centerpiece. Cards (M3, M4, M6, M7) are laminated card decks.

assets.purpose: Real two-pan balance scale (or cardboard prop) for class demonstrations.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical prop. Page is a setup-instructions sheet for the cardboard version.
